d: From sleepmaxxing to looksmaxxing, the internet has turned self-improvement into a full-time job. And now, “maxxing” has been crowned Dictionary.com’s Word of the Year for 2026. The trend is all about maximising every aspect of your life, from protein intake and sleep quality to jawlines and personality. But when every habit becomes a performance metric and every insecurity becomes another optimisation project, are we actually improving ourselves or just finding new ways to feel inadequate? Welcome to the internet’s obsession with perfection, where even burnout gets an upgrade:…
